findings.title: Missing owner for bin and litter-pick task
findings.detail: 'Arrange extra bins and a litter-pick team for the night' lists the owner as 'tbc', so no person is assigned to a task needed on the night.
findings.quote: | Arrange extra bins and a litter-pick team for the night | tbc | 2 days | Agree the route and the site plan with the council |

findings.title: Dependencies stated only in prose are missing from the table
findings.detail: The table's 'Needs first' column omits dependencies given in the prose, e.g. the risk assessment waits for first-aid cover and the event insurance waits for the finished risk assessment.
findings.quote: Last year they would not give us a quote until they had seen the finished risk assessment, so Ruth will do the insurance after that.

findings.title: Printing depends on road-closure approval which is not a planned task
findings.detail: Posters cannot be printed until the road closure is approved, but the plan only schedules 'Apply for the road closure'; council approval itself is not a task.
findings.quote: The printers cannot have the poster until the road closure has been approved, because the poster has the route map and the closure times on it.
